findings.title: Owner-to-owner studio helpers are not resource-studio capabilities
findings.assessment: The final composed closure contains 193 policies, 166 routines, and one view (263 direct rows; 97 wrapper-mediated rows). is_studio_comember accepts unrelated organization types/status; design-only owner helpers remain ambiguous across multiple studios.
findings.smallest_safe_disposition: Authorize against exact resource studio keys. Harden helper bodies, but never treat owner UUID co-membership as a resource capability.

findings.title: Unanchored schemas block safe delegated studio sharing
findings.assessment: 104 policy rows and 67 routine rows traverse nullable/unscoped proposal, client, lead, decision, saved-vendor, or template ownership. Per-row runtime evidence is included.
findings.smallest_safe_disposition: Add immutable studio snapshots; keep historical NULL rows owner-only; proposal snapshot must equal project.studio_id when linked.

findings.title: All helper-dependent permissive RLS legs must be dropped
findings.assessment: All 193 effective policy rows are permissive authorization legs, including 48 wrapper-mediated policies missed by a direct grep. Adding exact policies without DROP leaves the old OR legs live.
findings.smallest_safe_disposition: DROP each named policy and atomically recreate the exact-anchor predicate, preserving separately reviewed client/owner legs.

findings.title: Exact organization helper omits organization lifecycle/type
findings.assessment: is_active_studio_member checks membership status/role but not organizations.type=design_studio or organizations.status=active.
findings.smallest_safe_disposition: Harden the body; authoring additionally needs live designer-domain role and revocation-safe locks.

findings.title: Nine storage.objects policies require platform-owner handoff
findings.assessment: The nine exact policy names/operations are listed below; ordinary migration ownership must not be assumed.

policies.policy: Site request designers read immutable media

findings.smallest_safe_disposition: Use privileged platform-admin DROP/CREATE plus ordinary-phase sentinels; fail closed on ownership mismatch.

findings.title: open_project_direct selects an exact studio from an unanchored heuristic
findings.assessment: Moving 00484 persists/retry-checks studio_id but chooses the earliest eligible studio; caller and designer_clients provide no source studio.
findings.smallest_safe_disposition: Require p_studio_id from active workspace context and bind/lock the client relationship to it. Dirty 00484 remains provisional.

findings.title: 00485/00486 already eliminate eighteen effective rows
findings.assessment: 14 routine dependency paths and 4 invoice-line policies are separately recorded to prevent rebase regression.
findings.smallest_safe_disposition: Preserve final bodies/callee graph and exact policy replacements.
